d: More wholesome loli Towako goodness. Despite this being a Towako "Author Debut" story it's obviously Bonnou Obaa-chan's artwork. I know those blowjobs anywhere XD. Shame the loli's origin isn't explored. Can only assume she's some sort of mythical animal that evolved into a human form.
